svg.aria-label: Targets file: Pulse reads SYNTHWERK_PULSE_TARGETS_FILE at start. No API adds a target. Max 64 targets. http: A /readyz body from openapi/_shared/health.yaml gives status and checks. Other 2xx or 3xx is ok. down: A 4xx, a 5xx, a timeout or a refused connection is down. Pulse follows no redirect. tcp: Opens a TCP connection to host:port. For parts without a health endpoint, such as Postgres. Stored: The last status per target sits in pulse_target_status. The event goes to the outbox in the same transaction. Fast: Compose infra targets poll every 5 s. A stopped part shows as down in about 10 to 15 s
